en: Black‑and‑white view of an ornate European street lined with multi‑storey historic buildings featuring elaborate façades, balconies, mansard roofs and decorative statues. Shops and cafés occupy the ground floors, with awnings extending over the sidewalk and people walking or riding carriages in a small square in the foreground. Forested hills rise steeply behind the tightly packed houses.
